diagnostics.message: Output "dataset" exposes the dataset resource downstream but does not wait for the separate dataset-access resources to be applied (its sibling outputs dataset_id/id/self_link all do). When var.dataset_access is false, consumers using module.*.dataset can act before access grants exist; add google_bigquery_dataset_access.domain to the output's depends_on.

Output "dataset" does not wait for google_bigquery_dataset_access.group_by_email to be applied, unlike the sibling outputs dataset_id/id/self_link, so downstream consumers can read the dataset before its group access grants exist.

Output "dataset" does not wait for google_bigquery_dataset_access.special_group to be applied, unlike the sibling outputs dataset_id/id/self_link, so downstream consumers can read the dataset before its special-group access grants exist.

Output "dataset" does not wait for google_bigquery_dataset_access.user_by_email to be applied, unlike the sibling outputs dataset_id/id/self_link, so downstream consumers can read the dataset before its user access grants exist.

Output "dataset" does not wait for google_bigquery_dataset_access.views to be applied, unlike the sibling outputs dataset_id/id/self_link. Downstream modules that authorize views from this dataset rely on these access entries existing first.
